name: Shaman - Harmonic Resonance Weaver
description: Transforming the Shaman from a static buffer into an active signal processor, managing overlapping elemental frequencies and phase alignments across the battlefield.

bonuses.text: Striking a totem with Phase Shift causes it to emit an immediate secondary echo wave.

items.name: Resonant Tuning Fork
items.stats:
+140 Intellect
+115 Mastery
Equip: Converts standard totems into frequency emitters, creating a visual pulse wave on the ground.
items.flavor: A perfectly pitched instrument of the elements.

origin.baseName: Dormant Tuning Fork of the Ancestors
origin.details: Drops from an elemental ascendant in a mid-tier dungeon.

catalyst.details: Reheat and strike the tines back into perfect alignment, while mounting a resonant quartz crystal at the base to amplify the signal.

items.name: Grounded Vestments of the Phase-Catcher
items.stats:
+130 Intellect
+105 Haste
Equip: Increases the radius of totem waveforms and visually illuminates the interference patterns on the ground.
items.flavor: Woven with conductive metals to capture the storm.

origin.details: Elite elemental giant drop in an open-world storm zone.

catalyst.details: Insulate the inner lining, and weave conductive copper wire through the scales to act as an antenna array.

items.name: Charged Thunder-Striker's Baton
items.stats:
+195 Intellect
+140 Versatility
Equip: Unlocks Phase Shift. Strike an active totem to violently reverse its polarity, converting heals to offensive sonic booms or vice versa.
items.flavor: It sparks with heavy static even when held perfectly still.

origin.details: Raid boss drop from an elemental lord.

catalyst.details: Infuse the wood with pure lightning, and coat the striking surface in a volatile, hardened resin that sparks upon impact.
